entry_requirements: 'Para poder acceder a este Master en Composicion Musical online es necesario que los estudiantes procedan de titulaciones con una relacion directa con la musica. Podran matricularse aquellos que cuenten con: Grado en Musica; Grado en Musicologia; Grado en Historia y Ciencias de la Musica; Titulo Superior de Musica de Conservatorio en cualquier especialidad. Tambien seran admitidos aquellos que cuenten con experiencia profesional demostrable, de al menos dos anos, ejerciendo como profesor de Musica en conservatorios o instituciones educativas o director o instrumentista en orquestas de caracter nacional o autonomico.'
non_eu_admission_route: UNIR accepts non-EHEA degrees WITHOUT homologacion for official master's entry, subject to UNIR verifying equivalence: 'Ser titulado conforme a sistemas educativos ajenos al EEES sin necesidad de homologar sus titulos. Esta via no implicara, en ningun caso, la homologacion del titulo previo.' The only alternative route is >=2 years as a conservatory/school music TEACHER or as an orchestral CONDUCTOR/INSTRUMENTALIST - a producer/DJ record does not satisfy that wording either. Treat this programme as CLOSED to this candidate unless UNIR's admissions commission rules otherwise in writing.

non_eu_surcharge: YES — EXPLICIT AND SUBSTANTIAL. UOC publishes two separate price blocks. "Precios para estudiantes de la Unión Europea": "Precio por crédito 25,82 €/cr", "Precio por crédito herramientas y recursos para el aprendizaje 18,30 €/cr", "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas 5,16 €/cr", "Precio orientativo a tiempo completo (1 año): 2.900,00 €". "Precios para estudiantes de fuera de la Unión Europea": A tiempo completo (1 año) 4.330 € (hasta 9 cuotas); A tiempo parcial (2 años) 4.840 € (hasta 17 cuotas). So a non-EU student pays 4.330 EUR against 2.900 EUR — roughly +49% (+1.430 EUR) full-time, or +1.940 EUR part-time. Caveat printed by UOC: "Precios vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula. Sujetos a revisión anual" and "El precio orientativo indicado en la tabla está calculado basándose en un máster universitario de 60 créditos. El precio final de la matrícula será el resultante de su formalización efectiva."
entry_requirements: Requisitos académicos: an official university degree. UOC routes non-EHEA applicants explicitly — one of the four declared situations is "He cursado estudios universitarios oficiales en Latinoamérica o en otros países de fuera del espacio europeo de educación superior (EEES) y no tengo el título homologado", handled through the tutor after requesting access. Access request itself is free: "La solicitud de acceso es un trámite gratuito y sin compromiso". Documentation must be sent "en el plazo de los diez días siguientes a la formalización de la matrícula". RECOMMENDED ENTRY PROFILE (RD 822/2021 Anexo I knowledge fields), verbatim: "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas. Ingeniería eléctrica, ingeniería electrónica e ingeniería de la telecomunicación. Matemáticas y Estadística. Física y Astronomía. Ingeniería industrial, ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería automática, ingeniería de la organización industrial e ingeniería de la navegación. Ingeniería química, ingeniería de los materiales e ingeniería del medio natural." Verbatim on non-listed backgrounds: "Este Máster universitario en Ciencia de Datos está orientado principalmente a perfiles del ámbito de las ingenierías" — applicants from other fields are admitted only if they hold ALL of: basic mathematics (min. 150 h — probability/statistics, linear algebra); intermediate programming (min. 300 h — variables/functions, structured programming, OOP fundamentals, abstract data types); basic relational databases (min. 150 h — relational design, Entity-Relationship model, SQL); and introductory networks and computer architecture (min. 150 h — CPU/memory, operating systems, IP networks/Internet protocols, Linux at user level). "Dichos conocimientos serán evaluados por la Comisión de Admisión del máster." A preparatory course (6 subjects x 6 credits) exists for those who lack them.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT AND OPTIMAL. "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas" is the FIRST listed recommended knowledge field, and the four prior-knowledge blocks (maths, programming, databases, networks/architecture) are precisely a Software Engineering curriculum. UOC even steers non-technical applicants AWAY to a different master.
complementary_credits_required: 12 ECTS — COMPULSORY FOR EVERYONE, and this is NOT in RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4316294). Verbatim from the programme's own plan de estudios: "Para obtener la titulación de máster universitario de Ciencia de datos el estudiante tiene que superar 60 créditos ECTS entre asignaturas obligatorias y optativas y, además, 12 créditos ECTS de asignaturas niveladoras de complementos de formación." And on timing: "Este máster está adaptado al nuevo RD 822/2021 y tiene la restricción de matricular obligatoriamente las dos asignaturas de complementos de formación durante el primer curso académico, preferentemente el primer semestre... No se podrá continuar los estudios hasta que no se superen los complementos. Los complementos de formación son conocimientos de grado obligatorios para titularse del master." Every study plan on the page repeats the footnote "En esta planificación no se incluyen los 12 ECTS de complementos de formación, adicionales y obligatorios para titularse." ==> THE REAL LOAD IS 72 ECTS, NOT 60, AND THE REAL COST IS HIGHER THAN THE HEADLINE.
credit_recognition_available: YES — TWO NAMED MECHANISMS, and the most explicit credit-recognition route in this batch. Verbatim: "No debéis cursar en vuestro programa de estudios las asignaturas reconocidas mediante la evaluación de estudios previos (EEP) o del reconocimiento académico de la experiencia profesional (RAEP). Una vez se han incorporado a la matrícula, los créditos reconocidos se descuentan del total de créditos que hay que cursar para obtener el título." Recognised subjects are also charged at a reduced rate: "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas: 5,16 €/cr" (against 25,82 €/cr). THIS IS THE 300-ECTS LEVER: a 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree is the natural case for EEP against the 12 ECTS of complementos and possibly against core subjects. NOT FOUND: any published cap or guarantee — the outcome is decided case by case after requesting access.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UOC does not run fixed admission rounds — it runs semester intakes with rolling enrolment. The published next intake is "Inicio: 23 sept 2026". Access request is free and open continuously; the practical deadline is the enrolment window before each semester start. EXPECT (but do not assume) an equivalent late-September 2027 start.

non_eu_early_round_advised: Not a round system, but YES in substance: a non-homologated non-EHEA degree must be documented through the tutor, and documentation is due "en el plazo de los diez días siguientes a la formalización de la matrícula".

curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS = 36 obligatorias + 12 optativas + 12 TFM (matches RUCT exactly), PLUS 12 ECTS of compulsory complementos on top. OBLIGATORIAS (6 ECTS each): Fundamentos de la ciencia de datos; Tipología y ciclo de vida de los datos; Arquitecturas de bases de datos no relacionales; Análisis estadístico; Aprendizaje automático; Visualización de datos. TFM 12 ECTS. OPTATIVAS (6 ECTS each, choose 2): Análisis de redes complejas; Análisis de datos geoespaciales; Análisis de datos en entornos big data; Deep learning; Análisis de textos; Aprendizaje por refuerzo. One-year plan: 30 ECTS per semester.

Semester 1, 30 ECTS compulsory: Scientific Research Methods (6), Design and Manufacture of Microelectronic Systems (6), Reconfigurable Computing Systems (6), Advanced Wireless Communications Systems (6), Engineering, Production and Test of Electronic Systems (6). Semester 2 — General itinerary (25 places): four 4.5-ECTS electives from Hardware Acceleration of AI Algorithms, Cybersecurity in Networks, Design of RFIC for Telecommunications, Digital Image Processing Systems, Intelligent Embedded Systems, Advanced Techniques for VLSI Design, Semiconductor Devices (from 2026/27) + TFM (12). BUT Anexo 2º of the 2022 decree does NOT list this title — it is new (first taught 2025-26, RUCT verificación 18/07/2025) and the Anexo 2º list is updated annually by the Consejería (art. Disposición about updating Anexo 2º with the titles offered each curso). Its PREDECESSOR, 'Máster Universitario en Electrónica y Telecomunicación Aplicadas', is listed under ULPGC / Grado de experimentalidad 1, i.e. 15,15 EUR/crédito. IF the successor inherits grado 1, the arithmetic would be 15,15 x 60 = 909,00 EUR — but that inheritance is NOT CONFIRMED by any published source, so tuition_per_ects_eur and tuition_total_eur are left at 0 / NOT FOUND rather than invented. A human should open the current ULPGC precios-públicos page (https://www.ulpgc.es/admei/precios-publicos — returns 403 to automated fetching) or the 2026-27 Canarian decree to fix the grade. Additional fees that ARE fixed: apertura de expediente 36,08 EUR + tasa de preinscripción de máster 10,00 EUR; expedición del título de máster 218,34 EUR. NON-EU: no differentiated scale exists in Canarias. ACCESS NOTE: www2.ulpgc.es/plan-estudio/5059/actual is behind a CAS login redirect and could not be read; content here comes from the IUMA (ULPGC institute) pages, which are on the university's own domain.

language_of_instruction: Castellano — "Las clases colectivas se imparten en castellano"; individual sessions in another language by agreement with the teacher. English recommended for bibliography. No formal Spanish certificate demanded on the page (that is NOT FOUND, not 'none required').
entry_requirements: Título de Grado, OR Título Superior oficial de enseñanzas artísticas, OR an equivalent EHEA qualification giving master's access. Non-EHEA holders: admitted "provided the competent educational administration verifies that they possess an equivalent level of training" (comprobación de nivel equivalente — NOT full homologación). Selection is by MERIT ONLY, no audition: relevance of prior qualification 30%, academic transcript 20%, CV 20%, motivation letter + other merits 30%. The programme states it is "Aimed not only at musicians, but also at graduates from other disciplines such as Psychology, Education or Social Work."
tuition_total_eur: EUR 7,800 approx for the full 120 ECTS at first-enrolment rates (2026-27 rates). Page states 65 EUR/ECTS first enrolment (94 EUR/ECTS on re-enrolment) and full 60-ECTS year = EUR 3,900. Arithmetic: 3,900 x 2 years = 7,800. 15% discount for qualifying Musikene alumni (not applicable here).
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the Sept-2027 intake. Published 2026-27 cycle: 1st convocatoria 1-20 February 2026; 2nd convocatoria 15 April - 15 May 2026. Expect an analogous Feb / Apr-May 2027 window but this is NOT confirmed.
notes: *** THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT FIND IN THIS REGISTER FOR THIS CANDIDATE. *** It is the ONLY master in the whole Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas (Música) register that (a) is squarely in one of the nine fields (P — music industry/management/mediation), (b) explicitly and in its own words admits graduates of non-music disciplines, and (c) selects on merit with NO audition and NO composition portfolio. A Software Engineering graduate is admissible on the face of the published rules. Official title, MECES 3 / EQF 7, so PhD access and public-funding eligibility follow from the register (verify per case). Blended (semipresencial) delivery. TWO REAL FRICTIONS REMAIN: (1) the non-EHEA route requires the Basque education administration to certify equivalent level of training before admission — a procedural step that must be started early and is NOT the same as homologación; (2) teaching is in Spanish, and the candidate is A0/A1 now. Absence from RUCT is EXPECTED for this register and is NOT evidence against official status. Officiality evidence = the BOE homologation order (Orden ministerial) listed here, plus the Ministry's own register page infoartisticas.gob.es.
